tone.target: gated clean chorus delay with dark post-punk space
tone.profile: gated clean chorus delay with dark post-punk space
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a compressor for tight attack, followed by Chorus and Delay to build the signature atmospheric sound, anchored by a clean Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) and cab. The reverb adds necessary dark space without becoming muddy.
corrections: keep the tone cleaner and darker

rig.name: The Cure - A Forest - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tightening the signal and eliminating unwanted hum/noise.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Achieving the 'tight muted attack' and consistent dynamic level required for post-punk rhythm.
blocks.gap: None. Essential for rhythmic control in this genre.

blocks.purpose: Creating the signature rhythmic, shimmering chorus effect without sounding overly lush or ambient.
blocks.gap: None. Core element of the target tone.

blocks.purpose: Keeping the tone clean and avoiding crunch or big distortion.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting ensures no unwanted drive is introduced before the amp stage.

blocks.purpose: Simulating the JC-style clean, bright Fender tone required for post-punk.
blocks.gap: None. Best model for clear, non-overdriven clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Providing a bright, articulate clean sound that complements the US Deluxe amp model.
blocks.gap: None. Matches the desired Fender/clean aesthetic.

blocks.purpose: Adding the necessary rhythmic delay element for space and depth.
blocks.gap: None. Digital Delay is ideal for precise, controlled repeats.

blocks.purpose: Creating the 'dark post-punk space' without using a lush ambient wash (Room/Spring). Plate offers controlled decay.
blocks.gap: While Room reverb is often used for dark spaces, Plate provides more control and less of an overwhelming wash, fitting the Cure's aesthetic better.

blocks.purpose: Slightly brightening the high end and controlling low-mid muddiness for clarity.
blocks.gap: None. Used as a final tone polish to enhance articulation.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal depth for a more authentic post-punk sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the clean, bright JC-style tone and add vintage character.
